_comment: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation Finder programmes, read through the City's CARTO SQL API (phl.carto.com, the phl-oddt account the Finder itself queries). See the header of mapsee_ingest_phl_parks.py for what each rule below refuses and how many rows that was on 2026-10-04.
attribution: Schedule: Philadelphia Parks & Recreation Finder (phila.gov/parks-rec-finder; its backend tables on the City's CARTO account). Check with the centre before a first visit.
_weekday_ids: ppr_days, read 2026-10-04: seven rows, unchanged ids since 2016. An id not here is counted and its day never guessed.
_dropin_words: A programme is kept only when its OWN name or description says anyone can turn up: registration_status never does (four values, all about registering). Matched case-insensitively on the name + the description with tags stripped (+ registration_form_link when it is words, e.g. 'Drop in'). Bare 'walk in' is the verb ('a morning walk in search of birds', 'a 30 minute walk in the basketball gym': 4 of the 80 programmes the old list kept, 2026-10-05), so only the hyphenated noun or 'walk-ins welcome' counts.
_open_words: Weaker: 'all are welcome' / 'open to all'. Counted only on a programme with no fee (a $5.00 total/season walking club 'open to all' is a sign-up), and such a row says 'Price: free', never 'drop-in'. 'Open to all ages / skill levels / children' is about WHO may sign up, not about turning up (Game Night 'open to all ages', Waterview Chess Club 'open to all skill levels', In House Basketball 'Open to All Children Ages 8-16 League Play', 2026-10-05).
_signup_link: registration_form_link is what the Finder prints as 'To sign up visit: <link>' (its build.js). Over the 2,246 active, public and approved programmes on 2026-10-05: null 2,041, a URL 105 (eventbrite 24, facebook 22, opensports 8), an e-mail 52, a bare host 15 ('treehousewec.eventbrite.com'), other words 33 ('N/A', '20', 'Yes', 'Drop in', 'Come register in person'). A web or e-mail address there is a sign-up channel, and the programme is refused whatever its wording (Pickup Volleyball Games: opensports.net, $3.00 per week, live 2026-10-05). Words there are read with the description.
_registration_required: A veto read BEFORE the drop-in words: a programme whose own text says you must register is a sign-up even when it also says 'open swim' or 'All are welcome' (2026-10-05, among the 80 the old lists kept: Wildlife Walks 'registration required by emailing', Maple Sugaring Open House 'Registration required by emailing ... for a time slot', adult volleyball 'complete a one time 2-page registration form', In House Basketball 'Must be registered by 9/26/2025', four Sensory Friendly Swims 'Pre-registration is required'). The `registration_not_required` phrases are removed first, so 'No registration required' is never read as its opposite.
_care_and_camp: Camps, before/after care and after-school clubs are sign-ups by nature (a child is left in PPR's care), and their copy is full of 'free play': Summer Camp $500.00 total/season, After school program $20.00, Summer Camp - After Care $25.00 all passed the old word lists on 'free play' or 'Walk in/Late for camp pick up' (2026-10-05). Refused by activity type, or by the programme NAME ('Adult boot camp fitness' is a class, not a camp) - never by its description (stickball's 'drop in games ... during After School time hours' is a pickup game).
_deny: Refused before anything else, whatever their wording. Recovery fellowships are anonymous by their own traditions and a map pin outs everyone walking in (3 NA and 2 AA groups in the 2026-10-04 window). Matched on the WORD 'anonymous' and on what such groups call themselves, not on one spelling: on 2026-10-05 the catalogue also held "Gamblers' Anonymous/Accountability", 'N.A. Meeting' ('a support group for individuals in recovery'), 'Learning To Recover' ('A narcotics addiction recovery group meeting') and 'Friday Night AA' ('Alcholics Anonymous'). 'AA' is matched in capitals only (case-sensitive group), so 'aa' in a word never trips it. A civic association or council meeting is governance; a shredding day is a service, not a programme.

deny.why: a service day, not a programme

_not_weekly: The schedule table only knows 'these weekdays between these dates'. A programme whose own words say it is NOT every week is refused rather than expanded weekly: 'Third Wednesdays' on a weekly Wednesday schedule would invent three meetings of four (7 programmes in the 2026-10-04 window, 1 of them worded drop-in).
_holidays: phila.gov/city-holidays-and-closures (read 2026-10-04): 'All City offices close on holidays. This includes ... Philadelphia Parks & Recreation facilities'. The page fills its list from holidays_api, which answers the CURRENT year only (13 dates for 2026 on 2026-10-05). That list is read every run and joined to skip_dates: the rest of 2026 as the API gave it, and 2027 computed by the same 13 labels (New Year's Day, MLK Day 3rd Monday, Presidents' Day 3rd Monday, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving and its Friday, Christmas) - the 2026 list names the day itself even on a weekend (07-04 was a Saturday), so 2027 does too. A 90-day horizon reaches 2027-01-18 from 2026-10-20 on. Add 2028 when the run warns 'holiday list thin for 2028'.
